message: The other day, I found myself explaining to my kids why we have enough bottled water in the garage to hydrate an army. They looked at me like I was from another planet. But then, as the storm clouds rolled in, I couldn’t help but feel a sense of calm. Being gloriously over-prepared might seem excessive, but it sure beats the panic of last-minute scrambling. So, what’s your ‘just in case’ stash looking like?
